SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, KEY_2 AS UNIT_PRICE FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ATOB_PRICE' AND TARGET = 'KRNEPEG001' AND KEY_9 = ' ' AND ROWNUM <= 100
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT MAX(A.DESCRIPTION) AS ITEM_NM, TRIM(F_SPLIT(MAX(CATEG_PATH), '>', 2)) AS ITEM_GROUP1, TRIM(F_SPLIT(MAX(CATEG_PATH), '>', 3)) AS ITEM_GROUP2, MAX(A.SPECIFICATION) AS SPEC, MAX(A.UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT, A.UNIT_PRICE AS AMT, MAX(NVL(A.MIN_ORDER_QTY,0)) AS MOQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MRO_ITEM_CD, MAX(A.DELIVERY_LT) AS ITEM_DAY, CASE WHEN MAX(A.STATUS) = 'D' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS VALID_FLG FROM ICOMCQDT A INNER JOIN ICOMBYIT B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) INNER JOIN ICOMBYCA C ON (1 = 1 AND C.COM_CODE = B.BUYER AND C.STD_CATEG_ID = B.CATEGORY_NO ) WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' AND A.UNIT_PRICE = '$G_RS.UNIT_PRICE$' GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.UNIT_PRICE
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ATOB_PRICE' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.UNIT_PRICE$' AND KEY_9 = ' '
